provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: The emitted program works in visible coordinates. It finds the bounding box of the board colour palette[1], which is the 7x7 board. It starts a canvas of that size filled with the background palette[0]. The four marker cells sit at board offsets (1,1), (1,5), (5,1) and (5,5), and this set of positions is unchanged under every D4 transform. For each marker, the program copies all cells of the marker's colour that lie outside the board into the 3x3 quadrant centred on that marker, using offsets (0|4, 0|4). Distractor sprites have no marker, so they are ignored. Sprites from diagonally_connected_sprite fill their whole 3x3 box, so any corner anchoring gives the same result in that case. For safety, if a sprite's bounding box were ever smaller than 3x3, the program anchors it at the visible corner that the original top-left corner maps to under d4. The factory computes this corner by tracking (top,left) flags: a row reversal flips left, and each clockwise turn maps (top,left) to (left, not top). This matches the archived solver's anchoring exactly when d4=0. No grid is rotated back to the original orientation, and no colours are permuted back.
draft_notes.limitations: Not tested here. The program assumes the board colour palette[1] appears only on the board, which holds because sprite colours exclude 1. It also assumes the background is palette[0]. If the constructor could make a sprite whose bounding box is smaller than its 3x3 frame, the sprite's position in the output could not be recovered from the input. The program would then fall back to corner anchoring, which reproduces the original top-left placement. This case is not expected given diagonally_connected_sprite, but if it can occur it is a constructor ambiguity and should be reviewed by the host. No contradictions with the fixtures were found.
draft_notes.host_review: Factory unchanged; copies visible marker-selected sprites. Original fixtures unchanged.
draft_notes.host_sampler_revision: Bounded packing pins the 7x7 board to its chosen corner and retains all 4–6 requested 3x3 sprites. A too-small sampled canvas is resampled within the original 12–18 domain; no sprite is dropped. The sprite helper covers every row/column of its 3x3 box, so visible bounding boxes recover the intended origin.
